headline: Paramount Asks States to Shoulder Costs of Delaying Warner Bros. Deal
context: Paramount’s $111 billion deal to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery has been postponed until the conclusion of a trial, a delay the studio says could cost it millions of dollars.
